mapper.select: SELECT e.eval_id, e.application_id, e.interviewer_id, e.tech_score, e.comm_score, e.solve_score, ROUND((e.tech_score + e.comm_score + e.solve_score) / 3.0, 1) AS avg_score, e.recommend, e.eval_date, a.applicant_name, j.title AS posting_title, u.name AS interviewer_name FROM interview_eval e JOIN application a ON e.application_id = a.application_id JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id JOIN users u ON e.interviewer_id = u.user_id ORDER BY e.eval_date DESC

SELECT e.eval_id, e.application_id, e.interviewer_id, e.tech_score, e.comm_score, e.solve_score, ROUND((e.tech_score + e.comm_score + e.solve_score) / 3.0, 1) AS avg_score, e.recommend, e.eval_date, a.applicant_name, j.title AS posting_title, u.name AS interviewer_name FROM interview_eval e JOIN application a ON e.application_id = a.application_id JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id JOIN users u ON e.interviewer_id = u.user_id WHERE e.interviewer_id = #{interviewerId} ORDER BY e.eval_date DESC

SELECT e.*, a.applicant_name, j.title AS posting_title, u.name AS interviewer_name, ROUND((e.tech_score + e.comm_score + e.solve_score) / 3.0, 1) AS avg_score FROM interview_eval e JOIN application a ON e.application_id = a.application_id JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id JOIN users u ON e.interviewer_id = u.user_id WHERE e.eval_id = #{evalId}

SELECT e.eval_id, e.tech_score, e.comm_score, e.solve_score, ROUND((e.tech_score + e.comm_score + e.solve_score) / 3.0, 1) AS avg_score, e.recommend, e.comment, e.eval_date, u.name AS interviewer_name FROM interview_eval e JOIN users u ON e.interviewer_id = u.user_id WHERE e.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY e.eval_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_eval (application_id, interviewer_id, tech_score, comm_score, solve_score, comment, recommend, eval_date) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{interviewerId}, #{techScore}, #{commScore}, #{solveScore}, #{comment}, #{recommend}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_eval SET tech_score = #{techScore}, comm_score = #{commScore}, solve_score = #{solveScore}, comment = #{comment}, recommend = #{recommend} WHERE eval_id = #{evalId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.application_id, a.applicant_name, j.title AS posting_title FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id WHERE a.stage IN ('INTERVIEW1','INTERVIEW2') ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC
